title: kube.workload.resume input
description: Resumes one suspended pod Job (a finite job or a long-lived service) addressed by run id. The caller supplies the exact opaque resourceVersion observed at admission (via kube.workload.summarize or kube.snapshot.read); it is the compare-and-swap and is never re-fetched or interpreted by the runtime. Operation id, idempotency digest, worker identity, and exact patch are resolved by the trusted runtime.

expectedResourceVersion.description: Opaque Kubernetes resourceVersion of the addressed Job as observed at admission.
